newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 13.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Fire sweeps through apartment building in Taipei, killing two and injuring 61.
Customs agents find contraband liquor cargo worth more than T$200 million (US$7.3 million) on ship offshore from northern city of Taoyuan.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Likely arson fire kills two, with 61 injured.
Kazakh, Saudi jets collide in mid-air near New Delhi, killing 351 people.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Communications ministry will postpone raising tolls for highway travel, originally set for July 1, 1997.
Taipei tax bureau soon to start tax inspection on financial industry.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Canadian government says 10 Canadian immigration funds worth US$5 billion are illegal.
Mainland Affairs Council to complete rules before July 1997 to regulate China-funded investments in Taiwan.
